title: V2 Hypothesis on Emergence and Consciousness Mechanism of Large Language Models Based on Reciprocal Unit Coupling, Critical Dynamics and Local Entropy Reduction
summary: Abstract The emergence capability of large language models (LLMs) is a core puzzle in the fundamental theory of artificial intelligence. The prevailing scaling laws only describe the extrinsic statistical phenomenon of capability variation with model scale, and fail to explain the underlying dynamical causal mechanism for the jumpwise emergence behavior.
